lines.text: Your business runs on streams, but most decisions still wait for a batch job.
Now I B M Granite Time Series models run inside Confluent. Every event is scored the moment it arrives, with no training.
The same line of Flink S Q L looks ahead, and forecasts the next thirty-two steps with a band.
Once you see what comes next, you can choose what to do. The optimizer finds the most profitable setting that still meets spec.
Then an agent closes the loop: forecast, flag, reasoning and purchase order, in under a second.
For your teams, that means going live in days instead of months, five to ten percent more accuracy, and decisions in seconds.
And it works wherever a decision rides on a stream: production, anomalies, supply chain, fraud, search and trading.
Take card payments. Every card gets its own normal, so the odd swipe is held before it is approved.
It is already proven in the field. I B M Network Intelligence opens a ticket only when the cause is confirmed.
At a cement producer, thirty models became two, and accuracy rose from ninety-three to ninety-nine percent.
So bring us one stream and one decision. Contact us, and we will show you what it can do.
